title.en: Government Hospitals (Delegation of Powers — Ministry of Health) Notification 1998

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Government Hospitals (Delegation of Powers — Ministry of Health) Notification 1998 and shall come into operation on 1st October 1998.

2. The officers specified in the first column of the Schedule are hereby delegated with powers to reduce, waive or refund fees to the extent of the amounts specified in the second column in respect of fees prescribed under the Government Hospitals (Fees) Rules (R 1).
3. The Government Hospitals (Delegation of Powers) Notification (N 1) is cancelled.
